title: Partial Amendments to Accounting Standard for the Preparation of Semi-annual Consolidated Financial Statements
summary: Partial Amendments to Accounting Standard for the Preparation of Semi-annual Consolidated Financial Statements is part of the Japan GAAP framework.
description: This standard is part of the Japan GAAP framework issued by the Accounting Standards Board of Japan (ASBJ). It provides guidance on partial amendments to accounting standard for the preparation of semi-annual consolidated financial statements.
